newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM says restructuring plan can meet target.
newsitem.headline: KLM says restructuring plan can meet target.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines said on Tuesday its Focus 2000 restructuring programme was on target to increase operating income by 1.5 billion guilders over the next three years.
"The assessments so far confirm the possibility to structurally improve operating income by 1.5 billion guilders over a three-year period," KLM said.

The airline earlier reported third-quarter operating results dwindled to a 19 million guilder loss from a year-earlier 56 million guilder profit, undermined by spiralling fuel costs, a hefty wage bill and increased third party and landing charges.
